title: Yes

start.note: Teddy wakes to vacate notices being slid under doors. Prentiss is in the corridor.

objectives.text: Find out who's sliding the notices
Sit down. Eat. Talk to Ma
Ask Kearney at the front desk
Stick-up at the Rail's back door
objectives.tutorial: shooting: soft lock, cover, reload; non-lethal disarm still possible
objectives.note: Cops among the targets are ordinary killable police (heat only).

fail.note: Wasted: retry from checkpoint (hospital flow, Gameplay).
Arrested: retry from checkpoint (booking flow, Gameplay).
Shown as '<Name> died'. Retry from checkpoint; offer a skip after repeated failures.

moneyIf.why: Mayhew pays more to make the photograph go away

rewards.payNote: Mayhew's first week and the start-up cash for the round. The dialogue's '$200 a week' is the salary; the rest is float to keep.

mobile: Three walking legs of under two blocks each, with a checkpoint at each. The decisive choice is untimed. If the player has the M5 photo, it adds a fourth option ('Show him the photograph').
design: Teddy says yes to buy the Corwin time, and Mayhew promises it stays open through Labor Day (a lie). Showing the photo sets flag.mayhew_saw_photo (applied in the dialogue). The $200 advance is the first week's pay, and P1 makes it feel heavy. COMBAT (26 Nov): see COMBAT table in build_act1_missions.py.
conventions: FEATURE_AUDIT 'Mission conventions': cop kills feed heat only; 'Lose the police' gates on requireNoHeat objectives; fail only for standard reasons.
